evidence: Labeled Utils/log/libs; introduces AssertUnreachable in src/util/check.h.
rationale: The PR introduces a dedicated AssertUnreachable macro in util/check.h that eliminates compiler warnings and clarifies noreturn semantics across the codebase. As noted in the description, assert(false) causes clang-cl warnings and NDEBUG ambiguity while Assert(false) triggers GCC return-type warnings and obscures noreturn; the macro resolves this recurring burden across multiple call sites.
